---
title: "Our Liverpool"
---

```{python}
#| output: asis
import json
from pathlib import Path

routes = json.loads(Path("data/routes.geojson").read_text())
photos = json.loads(Path("data/photos.geojson").read_text())
n = len(routes["features"])
km = sum(f["properties"]["km"] for f in routes["features"])
print(f'<div class="stats"><b>{n}</b> people · <b>{km:,.0f} km</b> of Liverpool · '
      f'<b>{len(photos["features"])}</b> photos. Hover over a route to see whose it is; '
      f'click a 📷 to see the photo.</div>')
print(f'<script>window.GDSL_ROUTES = {json.dumps(routes)}; window.GDSL_PHOTOS = {json.dumps(photos)};</script>')
```

<div class="map-wrap">
<div id="map"></div>
<div class="people" id="people"></div>
</div>

<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/leaflet/leaflet.css">
<script src="assets/leaflet/leaflet.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  const palette = ["#1f77b4","#ff7f0e","#2ca02c","#d62728","#9467bd","#8c564b","#e377c2",
                   "#17becf","#bcbd22","#3b5ba5","#e6550d","#31a354","#a50f15","#6a51a3",
                   "#843c39","#c51b8a","#0b8fa3","#7f7f00"];
  const map = L.map("map", { zoomSnap: 0.25, scrollWheelZoom: true });
  L.tileLayer("https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png", {
    attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> &copy; <a href="https://carto.com/">CARTO</a>',
    subdomains: "abcd", maxZoom: 19
  }).addTo(map);

  const colourOf = {}, layerOf = {};
  const routes = window.GDSL_ROUTES.features;
  routes.forEach((f, i) => { colourOf[f.properties.name] = palette[i % palette.length]; });

  const routeLayer = L.geoJSON(window.GDSL_ROUTES, {
    style: f => ({ color: colourOf[f.properties.name], weight: 5, opacity: 0.85, lineCap: "round" }),
    onEachFeature: (f, layer) => {
      layerOf[f.properties.name] = layer;
      layer.bindTooltip(`<b>${f.properties.name}</b> · ${f.properties.km} km`, { sticky: true });
      layer.on("mouseover", () => { layer.setStyle({ weight: 9, opacity: 1 }); layer.bringToFront(); });
      layer.on("mouseout",  () => routeLayer.resetStyle(layer));
    }
  }).addTo(map);

  const esc = s => String(s || "").replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]));
  const photoLayer = L.geoJSON(window.GDSL_PHOTOS, {
    pointToLayer: (f, ll) => L.marker(ll, { icon: L.divIcon({
      className: "", iconSize: [26, 26], iconAnchor: [13, 13],
      html: `<div class="cam" style="--c:${colourOf[f.properties.name] || "#1f4e79"}">📷</div>` }) }),
    onEachFeature: (f, layer) => {
      const p = f.properties;
      layer.bindPopup(`<img src="${esc(p.img)}" alt="Photo from ${esc(p.name)}'s route" loading="lazy">
        <div class="pname">${esc(p.name)}</div>${p.caption ? `<div class="pcap">${esc(p.caption)}</div>` : ""}`,
        { maxWidth: 320 });
    }
  }).addTo(map);

  const all = L.featureGroup([routeLayer, photoLayer]);
  const fitAll = () => all.getLayers().length
    ? map.fitBounds(all.getBounds(), { padding: [30, 30] })
    : map.setView([53.4066, -2.9665], 13);
  fitAll();
  L.control.layers(null, { "Routes": routeLayer, "Photos": photoLayer }, { collapsed: false }).addTo(map);

  // people list
  const list = document.getElementById("people");
  const allBtn = document.createElement("button");
  allBtn.innerHTML = "<b>Show everyone</b>";
  allBtn.onclick = fitAll;
  list.appendChild(allBtn);
  routes.map(f => f.properties).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)).forEach(p => {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.innerHTML = `<span class="sw" style="background:${colourOf[p.name]}"></span>${esc(p.name)}<span class="km">${p.km} km</span>`;
    b.onclick = () => {
      const layer = layerOf[p.name];
      map.fitBounds(layer.getBounds(), { padding: [60, 60], maxZoom: 16 });
      layer.setStyle({ weight: 10, opacity: 1 }); layer.bringToFront();
      setTimeout(() => routeLayer.resetStyle(layer), 2500);
    };
    b.onmouseenter = () => { layerOf[p.name].setStyle({ weight: 9, opacity: 1 }); layerOf[p.name].bringToFront(); };
    b.onmouseleave = () => routeLayer.resetStyle(layerOf[p.name]);
    list.appendChild(b);
  });
})();
</script>
